title: cfs header
description: A boxed navigation drawn in 1px white hairlines over the hero photo: a mark and a monospace company name in a wide cell, then equal cells for each link divided by vertical lines. Hovering a cell (or the mark) fills it white with navy text in 150ms. On phones the box holds the name and a menu cell that opens the links below it.
notes: overlay (default) places it absolutely at the top of its positioned parent, over a hero; set overlay={false} to keep it in the flow
it is a `dark` subtree: white lines and text, meant for a photo or dark backdrop
the phone menu is a <details> disclosure: no JavaScript
